responsibility: Holds Blackfin’s common option-processing support, centered on the exported table of known CPU models, silicon revisions, and required workaround flags, plus the TARGET_HANDLE_OPTION logic that parses -mcpu forms with revision suffixes and special selectors like -any or -none. It maps command-line CPU names into backend cpu/revision fields, accumulates silicon erratum workaround masks, validates shared-library IDs, and establishes the target’s default flag baseline.
